newsitem.title: MACAU: Portuguese-ruled Macau hit by arson attacks.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese-ruled Macau hit by arson attacks.

text.p: More than 20 vehicles were set on fire in arson attacks in the Portuguese-administered territory of Macau on Tuesday, police said.
More than 20 motorcycles in a car park outside Macau's traffic police headquarters were damaged in the early morning attacks, a police spokesman told Reuters.
In a separate attack, one vehicle was set ablaze, the spokesman said. There were no casualties and no arrest had been made, he added.
Around the same time, six shots were fired, he said, but it was not clear whether the shots were related to the fires.

The attacks were the latest in a string of violent incidents, including bombings and shootings, which have been attributed to turf wars between rival triad gangsters vying for control of rackets linked to Macau's casinos.
The territory of 440,000 people, under Portuguese rule for four and a half centuries, reverts to China in 1999, two years after its neighbour, the British colony of Hong Kong.
